servo_web_unit:
# /home/radxa/.config/systemd/user/duck-servo-web.service
[Unit]
Description=duck servo-web 舵机调试台（常驻监控落盘；崩溃自动重启）
After=network.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=%h/servo-web
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/servo-web/server.py --port /dev/ttyS2 --host 0.0.0.0 --http-port 8080 --imu-bus
Restart=always
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
